_note: Ground-truth labels for the REAL container photos bundled in this directory. Notebook 07 copies these images into the container_images Volume alongside the synthetic set and UNIONs these labels into silver.container_image_labels, so the vision agent (notebook 08) classifies and scores them too. Schema matches the synthetic generator output: file_name, container_no, gt_damage, gt_damage_type. container_no is a descriptive placeholder (real photos have no known ISO number).
